line: for spd in set(s.creature.speed for s in stacks):
justification: Iterates set of speeds only to fill rank[s.id]; each key's value is independent of visit order, and the result is consumed via sorted().

line: return {t: (lab[0], lab[2]) for t, lab in best.items() if t != start}
justification: Dict `best` is insertion-ordered by the deterministic heap pop order; the result is a dict looked up by key, never positionally.
Import-time loader: os.path only builds the data directory path; no os call other than path joins is made (the lint flags any other os.* call).
The single sanctioned environment read: H3_DATA_PACK_DIR overrides the data directory (CLAUDE.md law 4). Read once at import; the value only selects where rules.json is loaded from.
The only file I/O: reads the data pack JSON files (rules.json at import). Content is validated and hashed; I/O errors become DataPackError.
Validation-only loop over a dict built in input-list order (insertion-ordered); it only raises on a bad reference and builds no state.
Builds the canonical dict from the validated rules dict; serialised with sort_keys=True, so order never reaches the content hash.
Builds a read-only mapping keyed by name from the validated rules dict; consumers look values up by key.

line: kw = {k: v for k, v in c.items() if k != "hates"}
justification: Builds keyword arguments for Creature(**kw); keyword order is irrelevant to the constructed value.
